001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.hullmods;
002
003import java.util.Iterator;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.BaseHullMod;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.CombatEngineAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableShipStatsAPI;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI.HullSize;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
013
014public class EscortPackage extends BaseHullMod {
015
016        public static float MANEUVER_BONUS = 25f;
017        public static float SPEED_BONUS = 10f;
018        public static float RANGE_BONUS = 20f;
019        public static float SHIELD_BONUS = 10f;
020        
021        public static float EFFECT_RANGE = 700f;
022        public static float EFFECT_FADE = 500f;
023        
024        public static Object STATUS_KEY = new Object();
025        
026
027        public String getDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize) {
028                if (index == 0) return "1000";
029                if (index == 1) return "" + (int)Math.round(MANEUVER_BONUS) + "%";
030                if (index == 2) return "" + (int)Math.round(SPEED_BONUS) + "%";
031                if (index == 3) return "" + (int)Math.round(RANGE_BONUS) + "%";
032                if (index == 4) return "doubled";
033                return null;
034        }
035        
036        public String getSModDescriptionParam(int index, HullSize hullSize) {
037                if (index == 0) return "" + (int)Math.round(SHIELD_BONUS * 2f) + "%";
038                if (index == 1) return "" + (int)Math.round(SHIELD_BONUS) + "%";
039                return null;
040        }
041
042
043        @Override
044        public boolean isApplicableToShip(ShipAPI ship) {
045                return getUnapplicableReason(ship) == null;
046        }
047
048        @Override
049        public String getUnapplicableReason(ShipAPI ship) {
050                if (ship != null && ship.isFrigate()) {
051                        return "Can not be installed on frigates";
052                }
053                if (ship != null && ship.isCapital()) {
054                        return "Can not be installed on capital ships";
055                }
056                return super.getUnapplicableReason(ship);
057        }
058
059        
060        public static String EP_DATA_KEY = "core_escort_package_data_key";
061        public static class EscortPackageData {
062                public IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.9f, 1.1f);
063                public float mag = 0;
064        }
065        
066        public void applyEPEffect(ShipAPI ship, ShipAPI other, float mag) {
067                String id = "escort_package_bonus" + ship.getId();
068                MutableShipStatsAPI stats = ship.getMutableStats();
069                
070                if (mag > 0) {
071                        boolean sMod = isSMod(ship);
072                        
073                        float maneuver = MANEUVER_BONUS * mag;
074                        stats.getAcceleration().modifyPercent(id, maneuver);
075                        stats.getDeceleration().modifyPercent(id, maneuver);
076                        stats.getTurnAcceleration().modifyPercent(id, maneuver * 2f);
077                        stats.getMaxTurnRate().modifyPercent(id, maneuver);
078                        
079                        float speed = SPEED_BONUS * mag;
080                        stats.getMaxSpeed().modifyPercent(id, speed);
081                        
082                        float range = RANGE_BONUS * mag;
083                        stats.getBallisticWeaponRangeBonus().modifyPercent(id, range);
084                        stats.getEnergyWeaponRangeBonus().modifyPercent(id, range);
085                        
086                        if (sMod) { //) && ship.isDestroyer()) {
087                                float shields = SHIELD_BONUS * mag;
088                                stats.getShieldDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f - shields / 100f);
089                                stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().modifyMult(id, 1f - shields / 100f);
090                        }
091                } else {
092                        stats.getAcceleration().unmodify(id);
093                        stats.getDeceleration().unmodify(id);
094                        stats.getTurnAcceleration().unmodify(id);
095                        stats.getMaxTurnRate().unmodify(id);
096                        
097                        stats.getMaxSpeed().unmodify(id);
098                        
099                        stats.getBallisticWeaponRangeBonus().unmodify(id);
100                        stats.getEnergyWeaponRangeBonus().unmodify(id);
101                        
102                        stats.getShieldDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
103                        stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
104                }
105                
106        }
107        
108        @Override
109        public void advanceInCombat(ShipAPI ship, float amount) {
110                super.advanceInCombat(ship, amount);
111
112                if (!ship.isAlive()) return;
113                if (amount <= 0f) return;
114                
115                CombatEngineAPI engine = Global.getCombatEngine();
116                
117                String key = EP_DATA_KEY + "_" + ship.getId();
118                EscortPackageData data = (EscortPackageData) engine.getCustomData().get(key);
119                if (data == null) {
120                        data = new EscortPackageData();
121                        engine.getCustomData().put(key, data);
122                }
123
124                boolean playerShip = ship == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip();
125                
126                data.interval.advance(amount * 4f);
127                if (data.interval.intervalElapsed() || playerShip) {
128                        float checkSize = EFFECT_RANGE + EFFECT_FADE + ship.getCollisionRadius() + 300f;
129                        checkSize *= 2f;
130                        
131                        Iterator<Object> iter = Global.getCombatEngine().getShipGrid().getCheckIterator(
132                                                                                        ship.getLocation(), checkSize, checkSize);
133                        
134                        ShipAPI best = null;
135                        float bestMag = 0f;
136                        while (iter.hasNext()) {
137                                Object next = iter.next();
138                                if (!(next instanceof ShipAPI)) continue;
139                                
140                                ShipAPI other = (ShipAPI) next;
141                                
142                                if (ship == other) continue;
143                                if (other.getOwner() != ship.getOwner()) continue;
144                                if (other.isHulk()) continue;
145                                
146                                if (other.getHullSize().ordinal() <= ship.getHullSize().ordinal()) continue;
147                                
148                                float radSum = ship.getShieldRadiusEvenIfNoShield() + other.getShieldRadiusEvenIfNoShield();
149                                radSum *= 0.75f;
150                                float dist = Misc.getDistance(ship.getShieldCenterEvenIfNoShield(), other.getShieldCenterEvenIfNoShield());
151                                dist -= radSum;
152                                
153                                float mag = 0f;
154                                if (dist < EFFECT_RANGE) {
155                                        mag = 1f;
156                                } else if (dist < EFFECT_RANGE + EFFECT_FADE) {
157                                        mag = 1f - (dist - EFFECT_RANGE) / EFFECT_FADE;
158                                }
159                                
160                                if (ship.isDestroyer() && other.isCapital()) {
161                                        mag *= 2f;
162                                }
163                                
164                                if (mag > bestMag) {
165                                        best = other;
166                                        bestMag = mag;
167                                }
168                        }
169                        
170                        //if (best != null && bestMag > 0) {
171                                applyEPEffect(ship, best, bestMag);
172                        //}
173                        
174                        data.mag = bestMag;
175                }
176                
177                if (playerShip) {
178                        if (data.mag > 0.005f) {
179                                String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_escort_package");
180                                String percent = "" + (int) Math.round(data.mag * 100f) + "%";
181                                Global.getCombatEngine().maintainStatusForPlayerShip(
182                                                STATUS_KEY, icon, "Escort package", percent + " telemetry quality", false);
183                        } else {
184                                String icon = Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("ui", "icon_tactical_escort_package");
185                                Global.getCombatEngine().maintainStatusForPlayerShip(
186                                                STATUS_KEY, icon, "Escort package", "no connection", true);
187                        }
188                }
189                
190        }
191        
192}
